summary: Nokia Corporation filed a Form 6-K reporting routine managers' transactions under Article 19 of the EU Market Abuse Regulation. The filing discloses the receipt of share-based incentives by nine senior managers (Louise Fisk, Patrik Hammarén, Victoria Hanrahan, Mikko Hautala, et al.) on July 9, 2026, outside a trading venue. No consideration or price per share is listed as the transactions are compensatory grants. This is a standard compliance disclosure, not a special situation, and maps to insider transaction reporting under US rules.
